info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Event History API provides access to detailed servicing event histories across various channels, identified by specific parameters. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve historical servicing events tied to a given parameter, effectively enabling analysis and auditing of customer interactions. Common use cases include customer support inquiries, transaction audits, and channel performance assessments. Ideal for financial institutions, customer support teams, and compliance auditors, this API streamlines access to crucial event data for enhanced operational insights.

get.description: Fetch detailed servicing event history related to the specified resource (RES-100045). This endpoint provides developers with access to historical servicing events, allowing for better tracking and analysis of resource interactions over time.
